title: Saw Palmetto for Hair: What the Research Shows

seo_description: What systematic review, a two-year comparison with finasteride and a placebo-controlled trial found about saw palmetto for hair thinning.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Merge target; old title called it a 'natural DHT blocker for hair loss prevention' and was unsourced; reframed to the studied outcomes. Redirected posts: nothing carried over.
flags: Removed 'DHT blocker' and 'prevention' framing; 'antiandrogenic' is the review's term.
Finasteride is mentioned only as the study comparator, with a doctor referral.
Ablon 2025 is preliminary 90-day results of a proprietary extract; stated. Review's percentages come from mixed products (some combined).
